findings.evidenceJa: すぐ目の前に遠坂の顔があった
findings.governingReading: Rin’s face is suddenly right before Shirou at extremely close range.
findings.explanation: The English removes both her face as the perceived object and the immediacy of the proximity.

findings.highlight: I can’t talk in a big voice
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot produce or project a loud voice.
findings.explanation: The English copies Japanese phrasing into the unnatural expression “talk in a big voice.”

findings.governingReading: Rin asks whether Shirou is bad at handling spicy food.
findings.explanation: The English changes limited tolerance for heat into a matter of taste or preference.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が出て行ったのは九時過ぎ
findings.governingReading: Rin left sometime after nine o’clock.
findings.explanation: The English changes a time later than nine into exactly nine.

findings.highlight: Information I don’t know in my head.
findings.evidenceJa: 頭の中に知らない知識
findings.governingReading: Unfamiliar knowledge is present inside Shirou’s head.
findings.explanation: The English produces a self-contradictory and unnatural fragment in place of knowledge he possesses without recognizing.

findings.highlight: I hit my forehead with my fingers
findings.evidenceJa: コツコツと額を指で叩く
findings.governingReading: Shirou taps his forehead repeatedly with his fingers.
findings.explanation: The English changes a repeated testing or thinking gesture into hitting himself.

findings.evidenceJa: とりあえず、目眩は治まってくれている
findings.governingReading: For the moment, Shirou reassures himself that the dizziness has at least subsided.
findings.explanation: The English promotes provisional relief into complete disappearance.

findings.highlight: I did indeed say we’ll go shopping together
findings.evidenceJa: 少し眉間に皺をよせると、確かに自分から、イリヤと買い物に行くと言ったのを思い出した
findings.governingReading: After furrowing his brow slightly to search his memory, Shirou recalls that he himself volunteered to shop with Illya.
findings.explanation: The English omits both the effort required to retrieve the memory and his initiative in the earlier decision.

findings.highlight: when we put the Shroud back on
findings.governingReading: Rin refers to the point when the Shroud was restored to its place.
findings.explanation: The English invents shared plural agency for rewrapping it.

findings.highlight: I was just a bit dizzy
findings.evidenceJa: ほんの少し目眩でぼんやりしていただけ
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he was only slightly dizzy and mentally foggy.
findings.explanation: The English omits the fogginess that directly bears on his missing interval and impaired awareness.
